classification.difficultyReason: Recover an edge from three products of unknown edge lengths, then find the other edges and volume without a directly supplied length.

content.prompt: The areas of three faces of a rectangular prism are 10 cm², 14 cm² and 35 cm². Find the volume of the rectangular prism.

answer.short:
$70\text{ cm}^3$

Find the common edge from the three face areas.
answer.worked:
Let the three edge lengths be $a,b,c$, with $ab=10$, $ac=14$ and $bc=35$.

$$\begin{aligned}a^2&=\frac{(ab)(ac)}{bc}=\frac{10\times14}{35}=4\\a&=2\text{ cm}\\b&=10\div2=5\text{ cm}\\c&=14\div2=7\text{ cm}\\V&=2\times5\times7=70\text{ cm}^3\end{aligned}$$
